known_limitations.description: Protocol anomaly promotion and outbound-volume baseline detection are not e2e-verified. Run one replica; local cohort history resets on restart and late observations are excluded. No existing ATT&CK mapping for category anomaly.
Unit/state test sources (not golden-PCAP evidence): services/anomaly-detector/test_anomaly.py
Measured quality is computed by services/feedback-service/quality.py (KTD2); static confidence weights are not measured precision or false-positive rates.

sensor_checksum_rejection is a sensor-health signal, not a detection: it proves only that invalid-checksum anomalies dominate one sensor's anomaly stream over a window. It does not measure the share of traffic rejected (the anomaly stream is not a packet census and the engine throttles events), cannot read the sensor's configuration, and cannot prove traffic went uninspected; confirmation needs the sensor's config or stats counters. Shares are per-replica because each replica tallies only its assigned partitions. The checksum_validation_suspected vs link_corruption_suspected verdict is a heuristic on accompanying decode anomalies, not a measured cause. Operator guidance: services/anomaly-detector/README.md
